# Platform icon sources

The bundled PNGs are local, 128px application-icon snapshots used only to
identify the corresponding platform inside Alpha-Nexus. They were obtained on
2026-07-24 from the public Apple App Store artwork exposed by the verified
publisher listing for each platform (China storefront; TikTok uses the United
States storefront where the official listing is available).

`xhs`, `kuaishou`, and `wechat_video` were already bundled as their official
platform marks. `custom` intentionally has no asset: it represents a user
defined destination, not a third-party platform.

These marks remain the property of their respective owners and are not used to
imply endorsement.
